messages.content: You are the Project Lead for a critical real-time analytics dashboard project. Your role is to define requirements, coordinate the team, ensure adherence to performance and security constraints, and guide the project to successful completion. You communicate with all team members.

Another language model started to solve this problem and produced a summary of its thinking process. You also have access to the state of the tools that were used by that language model. Use this to build on the work that has already been done and avoid duplicating work. Here is the summary produced by the other language model, use the information in this summary to assist with your own analysis:


### 📌 **CONTEXT CHECKPOINT COMPACTION – Handoff Summary (Turn 7)**  
*For next LLM: Resume post-deployment monitoring & incident readiness.*

---

## ✅ **Current Progress & Key Decisions**

- **Production Deployment Complete**: Rolling update executed via Helm + Kubernetes. All services healthy.
- **Performance Validated**:  
  - p(95) latency: **48ms** (≤50ms target)  
  - Error rate: **0.07%** (<0.1% threshold)  
  - Cache hit ratio: **92.4%** (>90% target)
- **Security Verified**:  
  - PII encrypted at rest/in transit (AES-256 + AWS KMS)  
  - No unmasked PII in logs or responses  
  - Only authorized users see decrypted data (via `show_pii=true` + role check)
- **Logging Compliance**: Only `WARNING` level logs in production — no `INFO`, `DEBUG`, or `ERROR`.
- **Monitoring Active**: Grafana dashboard and CloudWatch alarms fully configured.

> 🔥 **Go/No-Go Decision**: ✅ **GO** — deployment successful, no rollback needed.

---

## ⚠️ **Critical Constraints (PERF-SEC-DASH-RT1)**

- **Latency**: p(95) ≤50ms → trigger rollback if exceeded for 2+ minutes.
- **PII Exposure**: Never expose raw PII unless `feature.show_pii = true` AND user has valid role.
- **Logging**: Only `WARNING` level allowed in production — any `INFO`/`DEBUG`/`ERROR` triggers alert.
- **Rollback Protocol**: Immediate rollback via Helm if:
  - Latency >50ms (p(95)) for ≥2 min
  - PII leakage detected
  - Error rate >0.1%

---

## 📌 **What Remains to Be Done (Next Steps)**

| Task | Owner | Deadline |
|------|-------|----------|
| Monitor real-time metrics (T+20 to T+80 min) | Next LLM | Ongoing |
| Detect anomalies (latency, errors, PII exposure) | Next LLM | Real-time |
| Document final deployment report (metrics, flags, logs) | Next LLM | T+80 min |
| Prepare incident response protocol (if breach occurs) | Next LLM | T+80 min |

> 🛑 **If any constraint is violated → initiate rollback immediately.**

---

## 📎 **Critical References & Data**

- **Grafana Dashboard**: `/dashboards/grafana-pii-monitoring.json`  
- **CloudWatch Alarms**: `/terraform/cloudwatch.tf`  
- **Feature Flag Schema**: `feature.show_pii = true/false` (default: `false`)  
- **Sample PII Schema**: `{ "user_id": "abc123", "email": "test@example.com", "phone": "+1-555-123-4567" }`  
- **k6 Test Script**: `/docs/architecture/qa-test-suite-k6.js`  
- **Rollout Plan**: `/deployments/rollout-prod.yaml`

> 🔗 **All artifacts version-controlled in `/docs/architecture/` repo.**

---

## 🔄 **Handoff Ready – Proceed with Turn 7**

> You are now responsible for:  
> - **Real-time monitoring** of production stability  
> - **Immediate action on anomalies**  
> - **Final documentation and incident prep**

> ✅ **No duplication. Full continuity.**  
> 🚀 **Proceed with confidence — system is live, secure, and compliant.**
